text:
tori_singh: opening thread for ZephyrWorks enterprise POC. sales needs a conservative committed GPU recommendation, a short autoscale snippet for the SOW, and a one-liner for the security questionnaire about preheat. profile: steady 40 rps, burst up to 450 rps for 1-3m 2x/day. avg payload ~360 tokens, heavy tails to 1300. model: M-XL quantized (Q4_0).

max_evans: perf baseline: M-XL Q4_0 ~ 11k tokens/s per A100-equivalent at 512 seq; use 10k t/s for safety. steady tokens/s = 40*360 = 14_400 -> ~1.44 -> baseline 2 GPUs.

sophie_chan: bursts calc: 450 * 360 = 162_000 t/s -> ~16.2 GPUs peak. real plan: reserved commit should cover steady + SLA buffer; autoscale and burst credits cover short peaks.

diego_roberts: ops rec: reserved=7 (approx 3.5x steady) pinned across 2 AZs, min_gpus=1 to keep one warm, burst credit pool expressed as "GPU-second tokens" ~ 2_400 to cover short spikes. reserve7 gives good p95 headroom and single-AZ resilience for transient windows.

tori_singh: sales wants a pasteable autoscale policy they can drop in the SOW and a concise cost tradeoff blurb (3 lines).

diego_roberts: autoscale snippet (pasteable):
```
autoscale_policy:
  reserved_gpus: 7                      # committed pool (monthly)
  min_gpus: 1                           # keep warm instance to avoid cold latency
  burst_credit_gpu_seconds: 2400        # tokenized burst budget for short spikes
  scale_up_condition: p95_latency_ms > 350 OR queue_depth > 60
  scale_down_condition: p95_latency_ms < 220 for 6m
  preheat_strategy: kv_seed_top25pct && prompt_prefetch
  kv_seed_data: synthetic_only          # no customer PII for Redwood-managed preheat
  az_affinity: spread_across=2
```

max_evans: cost blurb for deck (concise):
- reserve 2 GPUs: lowest commit, highest variable spend (+~45%) and p95 variability during multi-minute spikes.
- reserve 7 GPUs: predictable monthly commit, lower variable spend (~-15% vs reserve2), stable p95 and AZ resilience.
- reserve 2 + large burst credits: middle-ground commit, cheaper initial fee, but may incur variable GPU-hours during repeated long spikes.

sophie_chan: security one-liner: "KV preheat jobs use anonymized synthetic prefixes by default and, for Dedicated/Private deployments, run inside the customer's network boundary; Redwood-managed preheat processes do not receive customer PII."

tori_singh: customer asked if we can run a customer-supplied preheat so they don't share any internal prompts. answer?

diego_roberts: yes: we support customer-run preheat container (we provide the image+runbook). customer mounts seed list locally and executes preheat inside their VPC; nothing leaves their network. add as optional line in SOW.

max_evans: can infra run a quick sim: steady 40 rps, 2x/day 450 rps for 120s; token mix 80% 256-512, 20% 512-1300. link: https://internal.redwood/sim/5188881234 (queued). i'll post numbers when ready.

infra-bot: infra-bot: preheat template created -> job id zw-preheat-5188881234; scheduled to run on commit activation. :white_check_mark:

tori_singh: ok thanks all. action items: (1) max follow up with sim + numeric cost delta (2) diego paste autoscale snippet & customer-run preheat option into SOW draft (3) sophie add security one-liner to questionnaire. i'll sync with sales in 24h. :thumbsup:
